newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Elec group to enter phone business - paper.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Elec group to enter phone business - paper.

text.p: The Mitsubishi Electric Corp group will start operating telephone services in nine Japanese cities in May, a Japanese newspaper said on Tuesday.

The Yomiuri Shimbun said a company in the Mitsubishi Electric group would use its intra-company lines between the cities, including Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya and Fukuoka, and Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp's (NTT) telephone networks within the cities.
The group's telephone rates will be 25 percent cheaper than current services offered by NTT and other operators, the paper said.
The Mitsubishi group will become the first non-telecommunications company to operate phone services, the paper said, adding that more companies are expected to follow.
A spokesman for Mitsubishi Electric was not immediately available for comment.
